description: Use this for one received fax: who sent it, when, how many pages, and pdf_url, a link to its PDF for 5 minutes, for apps that can download files. Getting the link marks the fax read for the person. To read what the fax says in the chat, use read_inbound_fax instead. Needs the person to sign in to Faxette.

organization.description: The organization's id from get_organizations. Ask the person which one if there are several.

name: get_inbound_fax

document_deleted.description: True once the document has been deleted. Faxette deletes them 30 days after they arrive.

document_deleted_on.description: When the document is or was deleted.

from_number.description: Who sent it. Null when the sender hid their number.

id.description: Pass it to get_inbound_fax or read_inbound_fax.

locked.description: True when it arrived after the organization's plan ended. Nobody can open it until an owner restarts the plan.

pdf_url.description: The PDF, for 5 minutes. Null when the fax is locked, failed or its document was deleted.

read.description: Whether the signed-in person has opened it.

status.description: failed: the sender's machine gave up before the fax arrived.

to_name.description: That number's name, like Front desk.

to_number.description: Which of the organization's numbers it was sent to.

url.description: The fax's page in the organization's inbox. Give it to the person.

title: Open a received fax
